text:
sarah.n: Heads-up — started seeing a spike of TLS handshake failures from services routed through eu-west ingress after last night's cert push. Also seeing KMS unwrap errors for the same customer traffic :thinking_face:

kevin.m: which error codes on unwrap? any 400/403 from KMS?

sarah.n: Logs show `KMS.DecryptFailed` for some envelopes and then nginx upstream TLS handshake errors: `SSL_do_handshake() failed (SSL: error:...:certificate verify failed)`

anita.p: can you paste a recent proxy log chunk? even a single sample helps.

sarah.n: pasted —
```
2026-03-20T02:12:05Z ingress-eu-west nginx[1234]: 2026/03/20 02:12:05 [error] 1234#0: *98765 SSL_do_handshake() failed (SSL: error:14090086:SSL routines:ssl3_get_server_certificate:certificate verify failed) while SSL handshaking, client: 10.2.1.43, server: 0.0.0.0:443
2026-03-20T02:12:06Z provisioning-service service[pid]: failed to unwrap key: KMS.DecryptFailed: key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...:key/abcd - status 403
```

marco.t: interesting — 403 on KMS decrypt usually RBAC/GRANT problem or key policy scoping to region. Did the rotation job change the service account used for unwrap?

kevin.m: we did update the cert-rotation lambda last night to use `cert-rotate-sa-v2` (new IAM role). If that SA doesn't have `kms:Decrypt` on the envelope keys, unwrap will fail and the runtime will present an expired/placeholder cert/backoff which causes handshake failures.

anita.p: check CloudTrail for `Decrypt` failures targeted at the key. Also check the key policy; if it's limited to account principals in eu-central only, cross-region requests can 403.

sarah.n: verified — CloudTrail shows `Decrypt` denied for `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/cert-rotate-sa-v2` from eu-west-1. The previous role `cert-rotate-sa` had a wildcard grant.

sec-bot: Automated alert: 12 DecryptDenied events on key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:.../abcd between 02:10-02:14Z.

kevin.m: ok quick mitigation options: 1) re-grant `kms:Decrypt` to `cert-rotate-sa-v2` on the key policy; 2) rollback cert-rotate change to previous role; 3) fail open fallback on ingress (not ideal). Which do we want?

marco.t: prefer not to fail open. Fastest path is key policy update, then rotate the certs properly. But we should also patch the rotation job to use a scoped short-lived credential via STS rather than persistent role binding — reduces blast radius.

anita.p: I'll prep a minimal key-policy patch and add an audit entry. Need approval for modifying KMS policy (prod). @sarah.n can you confirm which envelope keys are impacted?

sarah.n: affected keys list: `["arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...:key/abcd", "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...:key/ef01"]` — these are used for ingress cert unwrap and TLS session material.

kevin.m: also — we saw a small subset of clients succeeded. Looks like some nodes still had cached certs in KV cache and worked. That explains partial outage.

anita.p: drafting policy change now. Patch will add:
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowCertRotateV2",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/cert-rotate-sa-v2"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

kevin.m: make it scoped to the specific keys, not `Resource: *`. Also, add condition `aws:RequestedRegion` = `eu-west-1` to avoid cross-region misuse.

anita.p: good call. I'll limit it and add `aws:SourceAccount` check. Applying in 2 min as emergency change (will create audit PR after).

ops-bot: Deploy started: iam-patches/prod/key-policy/2026-03-20T02:20Z by anita.p

sec-bot: Notice: Key policy modification requires 2 approvers for non-automated CR. Override flag used by anita.p for P0.

sarah.n: after applying policy, unwrap errors stopped within ~30s and TLS handshakes recovered. Still seeing a few edge clients with stale sessions.

kevin.m: follow-ups: 1) add unit to rotation job to validate KMS grant preflight (call `kms:Decrypt` using a test envelope) before flipping certs; 2) tighten rotation role entropy via STS as marco suggested; 3) extend audit logs for `kms:Decrypt` to include caller role ARN in our central SIEM so we can correlate faster.

marco.t: I'll open a tech debt ticket for STS migration and add a canary run for cert rollouts across regions. Also propose a config: if unwrap fails, ingress should return 503 with `Retry-After` header instead of serving bad certs. Safer for clients and better for tracing.

anita.p: ticket created: INF-4521 "cert-rotation: preflight KMS check + STS migration". Adding owners: kevin.m, marco.t.

sarah.n: final note — RBAC drift is real. We should run a weekly job that compares active rotation roles against KMS key grants and alert when mismatches appear.

kevin.m: agreed. I'll add an alert to the infra-runbook: "KMS DecryptDenied spike -> check cert-rotation role grants -> rollback or patch key policy". :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Incident resolved: TLS handshake error surge mitigated, root cause: missing kms:Decrypt grant for new rotation role. Postmortem required if >= 30 min impact. Current impact window ~12 minutes.

sarah.n: thanks team, will draft a short incident note for postmortem inbox and link INF-4521.

kevin.m: cheers — let's also schedule a cross-region tabletop for cert rotation scenarios next week. :calendar:
